context_and_flow.screen_type: App onboarding or feature activation confirmation screen.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: To confirm that the user has successfully subscribed or activated the 'Kitchen Stories Plus' feature and to transition them back into the app experience.
ux_patterns: The illustration acts as a hero image, positioned centrally to reinforce the positive message of a successful subscription.
The illustration is representational and thematic, associating the service with cooking/food.
High contrast for the CTA button makes it the clear primary action.
The layout follows standard mobile UI patterns: top-aligned header, central visual, bottom-aligned CTA.
